image_description: A close-up, macro shot of two disposable lighters (one orange, one yellow) standing upright. The most prominent feature is a highly detailed, silver-colored metallic skull and crossbones assembly attached to the top ignition mechanisms of both lighters. The skulls appear to be fused or mechanically linked by bone-like structures. The background is a blurred wooden surface.
